name: retro-ui
title: Windows 3.1 Kit
description: Windows 3.1 structure with a modern finish: window, button, fields (input, textarea, select, listbox, slider), scroll area, dropdown menu, menubar, tabs, feedback and dialog.

files.content:
export { RetroWindow } from './retro-window'
export { RetroButton, RetroLinkButton } from './retro-button'
export { RetroInput, RetroTextarea, RetroSelect, RetroCheckbox, RetroRadio, RetroGroup } from './retro-fields'
export { RetroScrollArea } from './retro-scroll'
export { RetroListbox, type RetroListboxOption } from './retro-listbox'
export { RetroSlider } from './retro-slider'
export { RetroDropdownMenu, type RetroMenuItem } from './retro-dropdown'
export { RetroMenubar } from './retro-menubar'
export { RetroTabs, type RetroTab } from './retro-tabs'
export { RetroProgress, RetroBadge } from './retro-feedback'
export { RetroLabel, RetroSeparator } from './retro-label'
export { RetroTooltip } from './retro-tooltip'
export { RetroToast, RetroToastRegion } from './retro-toast'
export { RetroTable, type RetroTableColumn } from './retro-table'
export { RetroTreeView, type RetroTreeNode } from './retro-tree'
export { RetroAccordion, type RetroAccordionItem } from './retro-accordion'
export { RetroBreadcrumb, type RetroBreadcrumbItem } from './retro-breadcrumb'
export { RetroPagination } from './retro-pagination'
export { RetroDialog } from './retro-dialog'
export {
  RetroTheme,
  RETRO_THEMES,
  RETRO_FONTS,
  type RetroThemeId,
  type RetroFontId,
} from './retro-theme'

theme.font-rt: var(--font-plex-sans, 'IBM Plex Sans'), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
theme.font-rt-mono: var(--font-plex-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono'), ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

.rt-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-button:sin.background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom right, transparent 50%, var(--color-rt-ink) 50%), linear-gradient(to bottom left, transparent 50%, var(--color-rt-ink) 50%)
linear-gradient(to top right, transparent 50%, var(--color-rt-ink) 50%), linear-gradient(to top left, transparent 50%, var(--color-rt-ink) 50%)
linear-gradient(to bottom right, transparent 50%, var(--color-rt-ink) 50%), linear-gradient(to top right, transparent 50%, var(--color-rt-ink) 50%)
linear-gradient(to bottom left, transparent 50%, var(--color-rt-ink) 50%), linear-gradient(to top left, transparent 50%, var(--color-rt-ink) 50%)
